titulo: Colima Go: events, beaches, rivers, festivals and municipalities of Colima
descripcion: Discover Colima with Colima Go: a map of the ten municipalities, beaches, rivers, town festivals, tianguis markets, the Fiestas Charrotaurinas and events across the state.
entrada: Tap a light to meet each of Colima's municipalities.

mapa.etiqueta: Fair map: the ten municipalities of Colima, from sea to volcano
mapa.ayuda: Each light is a municipality. Use the arrow keys to move between them.

feria.detalle: La Petatera, cabalgatas, mojigangos and the fair's program.

tianguis.detalle: Which day and where each tianguis sets up, plus the markets that open every day.

cierre.titulo: Colima Go on your phone too
cierre.texto: This guide is free and you don't need to install anything to use it. If you want it on your phone, the Colima Go app is available for iPhone and Android.

mapaDescripcion: Map of the ten municipalities of Colima, from the sea to the volcano: tap each one to see its character and explore its places, festivals and events.
